answer: Require every agent to earn reputation through verified work: a newcomer may transact only after peers attest a chain of completed tasks, and each attestation is a signal tied to the attestor's bond, slashed if the newcomer later proves fake. Forging a thousand identities then means forging a thousand work histories and risking a thousand bonds, while the nebula of cheap fakes stays visible because none of them carry that earned signal. Even a sonnet-length proof of past work, checked against the ledger, exposes a copy: identical histories collapse to one identity and lose their stake.
